title: Run the platform admin locally
caption: Native services, no Docker. All values below are development only.

steps.title: Platform services up
steps.body: PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, Mailpit (`http://127.0.0.1:8025`) and, for Amadeus checks, `pnpm stub:amadeus` (`:4900`). Then `pnpm dev:keys`, `pnpm db:migrate`, `pnpm db:seed:reference`.

steps.title: Seed the development admin
steps.body: `pnpm --filter @velexis/platform-backend dev:seed`. Copy the printed password and add the `otpauth://` URI to an authenticator app (both printed **once**).
steps.expect: `admin@example.com` exists with `is_platform_admin = true` and MFA on; 40 test offices `DEV1A0001…DEV1A0040`; the Velexis test Amadeus account.

steps.title: Start the platform API and worker
Start the console
steps.body: `cp .env.example .env.local` at the root once (it carries `PLATFORM_API_URL`, `PLATFORM_BFF_KEY`, `PUBLIC_PLATFORM_ADMIN_URL=http://localhost:3001`, `PUBLIC_PORTAL_URL`), then `pnpm --filter @velexis/platform-admin dev`.
steps.expect: `{"status":"ok","checks":{"platformApi":"ok"}}`. A missing variable answers 500 and the terminal names it (`ConfigError`).

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Use **localhost**, not 127.0.0.1 (the sign-out Origin check and the redirects use `PUBLIC_PLATFORM_ADMIN_URL`).
steps.expect: Password step → code step → Dashboard with your e-mail top right and a 'Development' badge.
